name: Rekka Soursop-Lime Gummies
manufacturer: Rekka Sweets Co. (mid-tier Corponation brand under Halvorn Agri)
description: Star-shaped gummies in pale green and white, using synth-soursop and cold-pressed lime flavoring. Rekka positions this as a 'refresher' gummy — lighter and more tart than their main fruit lines, aimed at the mid-afternoon snack window.
flavor_profile: Creamy soursop sweetness with a bright, acidic lime edge — light, clean, slightly tropical
cultural_context: A reliable seller in Tier 2 and 3 office dispensaries and transit kiosks. Not a cult product or a status symbol — just a competent, enjoyable gummy that people reach for without much thought. The star shape is popular with children and adults alike, and Rekka leans into it with seasonal color variants.
story_hooks: A Rekka production facility in the Outer Ward is found to be operating with underpaid undocumented workers — a labor rights journalist is trying to get the story out before Halvorn Agri's legal team can bury it.

The soursop flavoring compound used in this batch has a trace contaminant that interacts with a common augmentation lubricant, causing a harmless but alarming blue tinge in users' saliva — Rekka is trying to quietly manage the PR fallout.
A Tier 2 child wins a Rekka-sponsored mesh art contest and is offered a factory tour — which accidentally exposes her to internal logistics data that a corporate spy would pay well to obtain.
